# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, welcome newcomers, and keep discussion about the project. Harassment, insults and personal attacks aren't tolerated in issues, pull requests or anywhere else in the project.

Report unacceptable behavior by [contacting the maintainer through GitHub](https://github.com/marchiartur), or use the **Report content** option on the comment or issue. Every report is reviewed and kept confidential. The maintainer may remove comments, close threads or block anyone who breaks this code.
